name: YUCLAW Ground Truth API
positioning: The open evidence layer for financial AI.
endpoint_case: JSON endpoints are case-sensitive: {TICKER} is uppercase (why/NVDA.json — why/nvda.json is a 404); the CLI uppercases ticker arguments for you

formats.evidencebench: JSONL — one item per line: {item_id, template (T1|T2|T3), question, key}; /evidencebench/meta.json carries the item-set hash and scoring rule

as_of_recipe: evidence as of D = evidence_objects with available_as_of <= D; classification at D = label_history last entry <= D; beyond the ribbon: the replay CLI
not_advice: Research and education only — not investment advice. Signal labels are research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations. Investment implication: none established — no buy, sell, or alpha conclusion is supported by this object.
